en-US.description: BDD test automation for UI, API and hybrid flows
en-US.longDescription: SDODS runs BDD test suites across UI, API and hybrid layers, with self-healing locators, data-driven scenarios and a local results dashboard. The desktop app bundles a Node runtime and manages the SDODS workspace, server and Playwright browsers for you.
